hypothesis: At one Prestige per faction, support purchases are pocket change next to the six-item collection goal, so support is an expense players barely weigh. At two Prestige, each faction meeting place becomes a real save-or-buy decision against holding fee plus boost for a contest, and claim assembly slows, which should thin the proclamation churn.
prediction: Support acquisitions per game fall by at least a quarter; Prestige spent on support shifts toward contests; claims per game fall; cancellations per game fall at least 20% (the frozen bar); median rounds and draws stay within the frozen guards; all four profiles still win.
refutation_evidence: Cancellations do not fall 20%; or median rounds rise past the guard and draws rise past 0.02 (support becomes a tax that stretches games); or the prestige farmer or early support collapses below one win in ten; or any mechanical or counterplay gate fails.
